notes: THE RESULT IMAGE for the IMG_7845 setup. Same chart, same untouched position tool, 2h04m later (chart header 17:18 → 19:22 UTC+5:30; Discord 20:30 → 21:55). All prices are read off coloured axis tags, not inferred: last price 1,706.61 (green, with 07:26 bar countdown), target 1,700.89, blue line 1,691.25, entry 1,584.45, stop 1,565.67. Box-edge positions were re-checked against the readable 1,720.00 / 1,640.00 / 1,600.00 gridlines and agree within ~3 points, confirming the drawing was NOT moved between the two screenshots. IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY TO CARRY FORWARD: the embedded SNDK Summary widget reads $1,702.505, +55.965, +3.40%, Jun 10 2026 9:53 AM ET — a 3.40% move in the underlying — while the message claims 'a cute 45% today just in few hours'. The 45% is therefore NOT the instrument's move; it is an unverified claim about his own (presumably leveraged or options) return. No position panel, no size, no entry fill and no P&L screenshot is shown anywhere, so the 45% is unfalsifiable from this image. Note also the widget price ($1,702.505 at 9:53 AM ET) and the chart's 1,706.61 are separate quotes taken at different moments — do not treat them as the same tick. The chart's own ticker legend is again collapsed to '...'; the SNDK attribution here is solid because the message embeds an explicit SNDK summary card. Final word of the message ('hours') is partly covered by the floating scroll-down button — the visible letters are 'ho' + 's', read as 'hours'.
